items.q: Oh yeah-yeah. A gang of them come down there. Let me see. Henry Busse(?), a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Can you remember the names of any other White musicians who used to come and sit in? Or who were good enough to come and sit in.
Oh yeah-yeah. A gang of them come down there. Let me see. Henry Busse(?), a trumpet player.
